toc.title: Cyriaci Lentuli ad Alethophili Germani epistolam responsoriam brevis regessio, quæ de præsentis novæ pacis Germaniæ causis politicis ulteriora reponit
Alethophilo Germano S. P. D. Cyriacus Lentulus.

book: A single early modern work, a printed letter-form treatise (1678) by Cyriacus Lentulus in reply to Alethophilus Germanus, built as a title page followed by the epistolary text with no numbered divisions.
